notes.title: Intro Gameplay Peek
notes.content: [p]Hey all![/p][p]I’ve been making huge strides on [b]Sneak-A-Snap[/b] over the past few months, and I’m finally ready to share some of the fun I’ve been working on. This project has been a real labor of love, and every week it’s been growing closer to the game I’ve always envisioned — full of playful moments, cheeky humor, and creative ways to capture that perfect shot.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="yPH03bAmQR0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Today, I’m giving you a sneak peek at the [b]intro gameplay[/b], including the cutscenes that kick off the game’s story. This is where you’ll first meet the world of Sneak-A-Snap, get a feel for the tone, and see how the adventure begins. It’s a little taste of what you can expect as you dive into missions, unlock gadgets, and use your skills to snap shots without getting caught.[/p][p]I’m incredibly excited because we’re [i]so close[/i] to the next milestone so stay tuned![/p]
